acceptanceCriteria: Every line of a run: block scalar body reaches the analyser
A list-item run: step is judged
diagnosis: Reproduced: a workflow step written 'run: |' (or '>') followed by an indented body, or written as a list item '- run: ...', is never judged beyond the key line: extractShellSources takes only the text after a line starting with run: and never starts a line at a list dash. Root cause: the extractor treats run: as a single-line key, so a block scalar yields the indicator character alone and its body lines, which hold the real shell, never reach analyseShell (fail open). Fix: recognise the block indicator, collect the indented body (literal joined by newlines, folded joined by spaces), and read the key after list dashes.
